blocks.x: The Achala IT Solutions build of Driisti Smart Vision Glasses — Architecture & Trust: concrete interfaces at core systems, measured movement on primary metric, and a delivery rhythm your control owners can plan around from week one.

The platform separates three planes. The data plane carries workload (regime mapping to controls and owners, cards, lineage, versions, documentation, golden datasets, judge panels, red teams); the control plane carries policy and orchestration (PII, injection, topic fences as code, AI-specific playbooks and disclosure flows); the evidence plane carries audit, replay and conformity documentation — the plane most vendors skip and every regulator asks about.

blocks.x: Compass treats governance as system behavior: policies versioned, evaluations gated in CI, incidents tracked to closure with owners. The output is an AI estate your CISO defends to the board and your regulator inspects without expeditions.

items: The control estate mapped to SOC 2 and ISO 27001 criteria, evidence produced continuously.
Sector rules translated into controls per jurisdiction — the mapping is data, reviewed when the regime moves.
AI-specific obligations mapped to controls — model risk, transparency and human oversight, owned by name.

blocks.x: Scaling is horizontal by design — workload planes shard by tenant and region, while the evidence plane compacts to cold storage on schedule, keeping audit queries fast without taxing production throughput.
The program dashboard tracks these by default, wired to your channels:

items: Breakage restored and measured — the repair clock starts at alert, not at someone noticing.
Up 97–99% of tables inside their declared window per workflow, reported weekly against the signed baseline
Batch windows measured against the plan every run — the number reported is the observed one.
Deployed inside your tenancy, your keys, your logs — the default for regulated estates.
Operated by us under contract — SLOs published, changes gated, your auditors given a walkthrough path.
Split by design: what must stay local stays local, what benefits from scale scales.

blocks.x: MLflow, evaluation frameworks, guardrail libraries, GRC integration. Adapters to core systems (CRM, ERP, core banking, EHR, WMS/MES, SCADA) are versioned contracts — one schema change propagates to every consumer.

items: A single governance plane over tables, models and notebooks — access your auditors can replay.
Typed schemas with owners and freshness expectations, agreed before a pipeline is allowed to ship.
Open table formats underneath everything we build, so your data never belongs to a vendor.
Data age treated like uptime — a budget, an owner and an alert when it slips.

blocks.x: Walk the architecture with the platform team — a working session that includes the evidence trail your auditors would test.
